messages.subject: For Pedro Sigüenza | Concessions, infrastructure and government partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Sacyr Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Pedro Sigüenza, Chief Executive Officer.

Sacyr's international concessions and infrastructure portfolio requires disciplined alignment across governments, communities, financing partners and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical teams.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, infrastructure stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Sacyr's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Sacyr.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
